services.name: Private BBQ Boat Rental
services.desc: Join us! Duration 2.5 Hours About Flat rate pricing for 8 people maximum, 2 adults minimum. 2.5 hour rental comprises of the first 30 minutes of your rental of a training session and boat rental licensing. The remaining 2 hours will be yours to safely BBQ on the water and enjoy the upper harbour and Gorge water way. Alcohol is not permitted on the water. It’s considered drinking or a a dui. Which is enforceable by the water patrols. What’s Included? Life Jackets Safety Kits Paddles Emergency Whistle Safety Instructions Fire Extinguisher Life Buoy Anchor Flash Lights BBQ & Grill Propane ($15 included in price) Storage space underneath seats Cleaning service Safety Lesson Bluetooth

services.name: Private Hot Tub Boat Rentals
services.desc: Canada's First Hot Tub Boats! No Boat license is required - Temporary rental boat license with your orientation Up to 6 Passengers! Duration 30 min orientation at the time of arrival before the 1 Hour & 30 Minute Rental About We are proud to announce the launch of Hot Tub Boats Victoria! Check out our progress in launching Canada's first fleet of hot tub boats. Private Rental Boats cleaned and disinfected before every rental Fresh clean hot water for every cruise Hot water maintained by the onboard stove and heated by compressed wood logs 1 bottle of water per person, Bluetooth speaker, and dry bags supplied on every cruise Explore the Upper harbour and the Gorge
